#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u

ROOT="/Users/kangsangmo/Desktop/Valuehire_v6/worktrees/hs-0002-20260910"
ART="$ROOT/artifacts/hs0002-20260910"
RUN_ID="20260909T220808Z"
OUT="$ART/codeaudit-rerun-$RUN_ID"
PY="$ROOT/humansearch/.venv/bin/python"

mkdir -p "$OUT"
cd "$ROOT" || exit 2

sha256_file() {
  shasum -a 256 "$1" | awk '{print $1}'
}

write_product_sha() {
  local dest="$1"
  {
    shasum -a 256 scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh
    shasum -a 256 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py
    shasum -a 256 humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py
    shasum -a 256 docs/sot/verification-commands.md
  } > "$dest"
}

write_product_sha "$OUT/product-before.sha256"
SCRIPT_SHA="$(sha256_file "$0")"
HEAD_BEFORE="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"

TMP="$(mktemp -d "$OUT/tmp.XXXXXX")"
mkdir -p "$TMP/scripts/verify" "$TMP/humansearch/tests"
cp scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh "$TMP/scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh"
cp scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py.base"
cp humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py "$TMP/humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py"

BASE_HELPER_SHA="$(sha256_file "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py.base")"
failures=0

run_case() {
  local label="$1"
  local mutation="$2"
  local expect_rc="$3"
  local expect_text="$4"

  local case_dir="$OUT/$label"
  mkdir -p "$case_dir"
  cp "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py.base" "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"

  if [ "$mutation" = "always_allow" ]; then
    perl -0pi -e 's/return 0 if has_failure\(output, sys\.argv\[2\]\) else 1/return 0/' "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
  elif [ "$mutation" = "always_reject" ]; then
    perl -0pi -e 's/return 0 if has_failure\(output, sys\.argv\[2\]\) else 1/return 1/' "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
  elif [ "$mutation" = "boundary_substring" ]; then
    perl -0pi -e 's/elif message\.startswith\(expected\):\n            suffix = message\[len\(expected\):\]\n            if not suffix or suffix\[0\] in " \\t\/":\n                return True/elif expected in message:\n            return True/' "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
  elif [ "$mutation" != "none" ]; then
    echo "unknown mutation: $mutation" >&2
    return 2
  fi

  cp "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py" "$case_dir/has-kickoff-failure.py"
  diff -u "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py.base" "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py" > "$case_dir/mutation.diff" || true
  write_product_sha "$case_dir/product-before.sha256"
  local helper_sha
  helper_sha="$(sha256_file "$TMP/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py")"

  local started
  started="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  local command
  command="env -i HOME=\"$HOME\" PATH=\"$PATH\" LANG=\"${LANG-}\" LC_ALL=\"${LC_ALL-}\" \"$PY\" -m pytest -q \"$TMP/humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py\""
  printf '%s\n' "$command" > "$case_dir/command.txt"
  env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" LANG="${LANG-}" LC_ALL="${LC_ALL-}" "$PY" -m pytest -q "$TMP/humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py" > "$case_dir/pytest.stdout" 2> "$case_dir/pytest.stderr"
  local rc=$?
  local ended
  ended="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  write_product_sha "$case_dir/product-after.sha256"

  local assertion_ok=0
  if [ "$expect_text" = "20 passed" ]; then
    if [ "$rc" -eq "$expect_rc" ] && grep -q '20 passed' "$case_dir/pytest.stdout"; then assertion_ok=1; fi
  else
    if [ "$rc" -eq "$expect_rc" ] && grep -q 'AssertionError' "$case_dir/pytest.stdout"; then assertion_ok=1; fi
  fi

  {
    printf 'label=%s\n' "$label"
    printf 'mutation=%s\n' "$mutation"
    printf 'started=%s\n' "$started"
    printf 'ended=%s\n' "$ended"
    printf 'exit_code=%s\n' "$rc"
    printf 'expected_exit_code=%s\n' "$expect_rc"
    printf 'expectation=%s\n' "$expect_text"
    printf 'expectation_met=%s\n' "$assertion_ok"
    printf 'base_helper_sha256=%s\n' "$BASE_HELPER_SHA"
    printf 'case_helper_sha256=%s\n' "$helper_sha"
    printf 'mutation_diff=%s\n' "$case_dir/mutation.diff"
    printf 'pytest_stdout=%s\n' "$case_dir/pytest.stdout"
    printf 'pytest_stderr=%s\n' "$case_dir/pytest.stderr"
    printf 'command_file=%s\n' "$case_dir/command.txt"
    printf 'product_before_sha256=%s\n' "$case_dir/product-before.sha256"
    printf 'product_after_sha256=%s\n' "$case_dir/product-after.sha256"
  } > "$case_dir/case.meta"

  if [ "$assertion_ok" -ne 1 ]; then
    failures=$((failures + 1))
  fi
}

run_case normal none 0 "20 passed"
run_case always_allow always_allow 1 "AssertionError"
run_case always_reject always_reject 1 "AssertionError"
run_case boundary_substring boundary_substring 1 "AssertionError"

write_product_sha "$OUT/product-after.sha256"
HEAD_AFTER="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"

"$PY" - <<'PY' "$OUT" "$SCRIPT_SHA" "$HEAD_BEFORE" "$HEAD_AFTER" "$TMP" "$failures"
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

out = Path(sys.argv[1])
script_sha = sys.argv[2]
head_before = sys.argv[3]
head_after = sys.argv[4]
tmp = sys.argv[5]
failures = int(sys.argv[6])

def read_meta(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    data = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if "=" in line:
            key, value = line.split("=", 1)
            data[key] = value
    return data

cases = []
for label in ("normal", "always_allow", "always_reject", "boundary_substring"):
    meta = read_meta(out / label / "case.meta")
    meta["actual_assertion_failure_checked"] = (
        meta["expectation"] == "AssertionError" and meta["expectation_met"] == "1"
    )
    meta["normal_20_pass_checked"] = (
        meta["expectation"] == "20 passed" and meta["expectation_met"] == "1"
    )
    cases.append(meta)

ledger = {
    "run_kind": "codeaudit-rerun-normal-plus-three-mutants",
    "note": "New independent rerun evidence. This does not retroactively prove the earlier truncated mutant output; earlier source gap remains documented.",
    "script_path": "artifacts/hs0002-20260910/codeaudit-rerun-mutants-20260909T220808Z.sh",
    "script_sha256": script_sha,
    "run_dir": str(out),
    "copy_dir": tmp,
    "head_before": head_before,
    "head_after": head_after,
    "product_before_sha256": str(out / "product-before.sha256"),
    "product_after_sha256": str(out / "product-after.sha256"),
    "exit_code": 0 if failures == 0 else 1,
    "cases": cases,
    "environment": {
        "env_clean": "Executed pytest with env -i and only HOME/PATH/LANG/LC_ALL. GIT_*, BASH_ENV and ENV were not passed."
    },
}
(out / "ledger.json").write_text(json.dumps(ledger, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
PY

exit "$failures"
